lines.en: Mother, what is in this recipe?
Eggs, milk, and sugar are the ingredients.
Should I mix them in this bowl?
Yes. Pour the milk slowly and stir well.
lines.ko: 네. 우유를 천천히 붓고 잘 저어요.

lines.en: Is the oven hot enough now?
I turned it on ten minutes ago.
Good. I will bake the bread first.
Please put on an apron. Your dress is white.
Thank you. Do we chop the onions too?
Yes, and we will fry them for lunch.
Good morning. Please put on your apron.
Hello. What will we cook today?
We will bake a small cake today.
May I see the recipe, please?
Here. Read the ingredients on the first line.
lines.ko: 여기요. 첫 줄의 재료를 읽어 보세요.

lines.en: Do I chop the apples now?
Yes. Then mix them with sugar and stir.
Last week my cake was too dry.
Pour more milk, and the cake will be soft.
lines.ko: 우유를 더 부으면 케이크가 부드러워질 거예요.

lines.en: Thank you. I am learning a lot here.
